race.comment: ASTON FONTAINE (1) has recorded back to back wins, the quickest two back at Ballarat in 22.01. Can continue the winning form. STAR BLUEY (2) has a strong record here with three wins and two placings from eight starts. Recorded a 0.6 lengths win (22.65) in a Grade 5 last time at this track. Looks well placed here and among the chances. STAR MELI (5) stalked the lead from the inside draw before finishing second last start (22.21) at this track in Grade 4/5 over 390m. Can measure up. RAGING ELSA (3) won as punters' elect last time and is a major player again.
